set_aside.subject: command-line argument-count validation at kernel start
set_aside.text: State 4 assigns the check to `capability:surface.serve_kernel` and identifies failures as “a command line without exactly one argument (`module:surface`)”, while State 3 says `module:installation` owns “A17: the configuration file and its start checks”, and A17 says “with none or more than one it refuses to start too”.
set_aside.question: Which module owns and performs the exactly-one-command-line-argument check: `surface` or `installation`?
options: `surface` validates the argument count and passes the sole path to `installation.load_installation`
`installation.load_installation` receives the command line and validates its argument count
set_aside.default_guess: `surface` validates the argument count and passes the sole argument to `installation.load_installation`.
